projectDescription: A Nuxt 3 module that provides type-safe Calendly integration through auto-loaded components and composables.
keyFeatures: Auto-loaded CalendlyInlineWidget, CalendlyPopupButton, and CalendlyPopupWidget components
useCalendly() composable exposing all Calendly widget.js methods
useCalendlyEventListener() composable for responding to Calendly events
Full TypeScript support with complete type definitions
Prefill support for scheduling forms (name, email, custom answers, etc.)
PageSettings for styling the embedded Calendly widget
publicApiSurface: useCalendly() — closePopupWidget, destroyBadgeWidget, initBadgeWidget, initPopupWidget, initInlineWidget, showPopupWidget
useCalendlyEventListener({ onDateAndTimeSelected, onEventScheduled, onEventTypeViewed, onProfilePageViewed, onPageHeightResize })
CalendlyEvent enum — PROFILE_PAGE_VIEWED, EVENT_TYPE_VIEWED, DATE_AND_TIME_SELECTED, EVENT_SCHEDULED, PAGE_HEIGHT
Types — Prefill, Utm, PageSettings, IframeTitle, CalendlyInlineWidgetOptions, CalendlyPopupButtonOptions, CalendlyPopupWidgetOptions
